test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"presented"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Presented" **is the verb form of **give** or **make known**.
 
• Here **the arab** gave the **bottle** to the audience.
 
• As the bottle is given as a **gift**, the word **"presented"** is the correct form of verb.

The correct answer is **"he presented__ him with the bottle of water."**
